notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36367529/ad88420d9b32ad8bf800f83cb16e27322e4e2da0.jpg[/img]

- New waypoint added next to Bigie Summon Portal.

- After starting a new difficulty, damage dealt and received was 0 and mobs wouldn't spawn in first map. It's fixed.
- Level 14 map was gliching and causing collision problems. It's fixed.
- Mouse cursor is now locked to screen.
- 4th and 5th tier bounty icons were in wrong spots at the bottom of bounty page. It's fixed.
- Spamming in merchant buy section was spending materials but not giving enough items. It's fixed.


If you encounter any bugs, feel free to share them on Quicksave discord server: https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36367529/3538e1ceaf256f5d95054cf440df0d9658066a43.jpg[/img]

[b]Remnants[/b] are additional upgrades to your stats. They only drop from bosses.
You can have maximum 10 remnants on you and you lose all of them when you die.

- Remnants were disabled at the launch due to some problems. They are now enabled and functional in the game.
- Bounty prices were not applicable to chests. They are fixed.
- Shield value is now visible under health value, when you gain shield.
- Level count on level achievements were starting from 0 instead of 1. That is fixed.
[h2][/h2]

If you encounter any bugs, feel free to share them on Quicksave discord server: https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36367529/fcaa3881c9e4c628a846d1b3f11ba20d5032fae5.jpg[/img]

- Tips are added for stats. Now you can see exactly how much that stat does effect when you hover on that stat.
- Now you can attack continuously when you press down left mouse button. Attack stops when you release it.


If you encounter any bugs, feel free to share them on Quicksave discord server: https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj
